# TinyStudio.io

TinyStudio sells a Tangible Revenue Leak Sprint + Search Trust Layer.

Canonical URL: https://tinystudio.io/
Contact: hello@tinystudio.io

## Offer

TinyStudio runs a 7-day sprint for founder-led businesses that already have a website and real customer context such as traffic, sales, reviews, ads, emails, customer messages, or analytics.

The sprint finds buyer-facing website leaks, rewrites priority page sections, reviews search trust basics, and produces a 30-day action plan.

## Price

- First proof clients: $1,000.
- Standard sprint: $2,500-$5,000.
- Weekly Growth Desk continuation: $2,000-$5,000/month.

## Guarantees And Limits

TinyStudio does not promise revenue, ROAS, SEO rankings, AI visibility, conversion lift, or sales lift.

Before payment, if TinyStudio cannot name at least one concrete public-site leak worth investigating, it should not take the sprint.

After payment, payment is refundable until intake is submitted or TinyStudio begins sprint work, whichever happens first.

If an included deliverable is missing after work starts, TinyStudio will complete the missing item once at no extra charge within 5 business days.

## Human Review

TinyStudio's operator records Loom audits. Internal systems prepare briefs, checklists, and proof ledgers, but a human reviews the page and explains recommendations.
